Garden Landscaping

We landscape back gardens with new patios, paths, paved areas and fencing, planned around how you use the garden.

Call 01472 306134 WhatsApp Us

Planned Around How You Use It

In Bridlington, John B wanted a resin patio for his mother. We helped him pick a resin colour that wouldn't show up the leaves blowing onto it, left a border along the sides so she could have a flower garden, and raised the patio slightly so the step down from the conservatory was easier for her. He tells it better than we can:

"He advised me on everything from the colour of the resin to minimise the showing up of any leaves etc that might blow on to the resin to how we could leave a border around the patio sides so my mother could have a flower garden at the side of the patio. To raising the height slightly so the step down from the conservatory was more manageable for her."

John B, Bridlington (YO15), Checkatrade

Fencing

If the garden needs closing in, new fence panels go up as part of the job. The two gardens in the photos were finished with grey slab patios and new timber fencing, and in Grimsby we laid a slab path and a patio and put up a small fence for one customer.

Roofers and Landscapers

We're roofers as well as landscapers, all under one name. If the garden and the roof both need work, you only have to make one call, and one team of five does both.

How Long It Takes

Most of our jobs take 1 to 3 days.

When a Garden Is Worth Doing

  • The lawn has worn to mud where everyone walks
  • Old fencing that is leaning, broken or rotten
  • There's no flat, dry space to put a table and chairs
